detail.longDescription:
Weekend project idea: Mixtape.

A web app for making someone a mixtape the old way. You pick every song yourself; no suggestions. Each side has a hard time limit. It goes to one person only, with a short note on the inlay card.

The person you give it to knows it's from you and sees the song that's playing, but not the tracklist. No skipping; they listen in the order you made it.

Retro tape deck UI, obviously.

Would you use this? Who would you make one for?

#WebDev #Music
